properties.text: Tsunami Information for Hawaii from the PTWC
Tsunami Information Bulletin from the PTWC

contents.bytes: Four people killed, more than 100 injured and 22 buildings damaged or destroyed in the Ormoc-Kananya area. A runway was damaged at Ormoc Airport. Damage estimated at 5.3 million U.S. dollars. Landslides occurred at Carigara and Villaba. Power outages occurred in Eastern Visayas and nearby Bohol.
